title: The Foundry Brothers' Feud
logline: Two estranged brothers operating rival smelting platforms engage in a cutthroat economic war over silicate flux ore, hiring private mercenaries to seize each other's supply convoys.

roles.description: Manages the high-tier blast furnace; arrogant, methodical, determined to force his younger sibling into liquidation.
Manages the cooperative re-smelting dock; passionate, protective of his foundry crew, refusing corporate buyout offers.
An armed heavy freighter guarding the elder brother's bulk silicate transports.
The association of independent orbital foundry workers caught between the brothers' feuding docks.
The industrial mineral processing trust seeking to absorb both family smelters into a regional monopoly.
A massive industrial smelting platform dominating the system's primary ironworks.
A converted salvage habitat where the younger brother runs an independent recycled metal forge.
An icy asteroid outcrop in the mineral belt yielding high-purity smelting flux.

public_situation: Smelting prices fluctuate wildly across {system} as rival family foundries accuse each other of monopolizing silicate ore flux.
private_truth: {role:elder_brother} entered a secret cartel agreement to drive his brother's cooperative into bankruptcy in exchange for a permanent board seat.

beats.public_change: The cooperative foundry lowers its production blast horns as raw flux reserves dwindle to emergency thresholds.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to mine and deliver silicate flux from the outer belt to keep the cooperative's blast furnaces burning through the supply squeeze.
missions.private_fact: His foundry only has enough liquid fuel to maintain ladle temperatures for another twenty-four hours.

beats.public_change: {role:foundry_cartel} posts a public purchase offer for the cooperative's berths, backed by default foreclosure filings.

missions.reason: He needs a pilot to scan the elder brother's intake manifest beacon and uncover proof that the cartel is secretly subsidizing his brother's purchase orders.
missions.private_fact: Their late father left the original foundry patent to both brothers jointly, prohibiting corporate buyout agreements.

beats.public_change: {role:brother_escort} maneuvers into the cooperative approach lane, enforcing an armed perimeter against incoming freighters.

missions.reason: He needs his brother's armed escort cutter disabled before its gunners blockade the cooperative's docking approaches.
missions.private_fact: The escort captain hails offering fifty thousand credits and a guaranteed furnace maintenance contract if the pilot turns over the cartel files.

beats.public_change: Union delegates gather at {role:cooperative_dock} as arbiters prepare to hear the emergency patent violation petition.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to courier the documented partnership violations directly to the smelters union tribunal before the elder brother files foreclosure papers.
missions.private_fact: He hopes the tribunal will force his brother back into the original family partnership rather than putting him in prison.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands before the union arbiters as both brothers present their operational balance sheets.

options.label: Present the collusion proof and restore the joint family charter under union oversight
Void the elder brother's title and award sole ownership of the furnaces to the cooperative
Sell the collusion proof to the elder brother to let the corporate buyout proceed

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the collusion proof and union arbiters enforce the family patent.
resolutions.summary: The union tribunal upholds the family charter. Both brothers are mandated into a supervised partnership, breaking the cartel's regional price stranglehold.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broke an armed blockade to expose corporate collusion and force two feuding foundry brothers to share the family blast furnace.

resolutions.reached_by: The arbiters void the elder brother's title for anti-union collusion.
resolutions.summary: The elder brother is stripped of his charter for corporate collusion. {role:younger_brother} assumes control of both facilities, expanding worker-owned smelting operations.

consequences.public_summary: Smelter hands celebrate a pilot who proved a foundry director was colluding with cartels to break his brother's union.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the cartel payout or sells the evidence to the elder brother.
resolutions.summary: The evidence is buried. {role:foundry_cartel} forecloses on both facilities, shutting down the independent cooperative and eliminating independent smelting in {system}.

resolutions.reached_by: Ore deliveries fail or the tribunal petition deadline expires.
resolutions.summary: Silicate shortages force the cooperative to drop its fires. {role:younger_brother} is forced out, and {role:elder_brother} consolidates power under cartel backing.

loose_threads.detail: The silicate shipment containers bear pre-stamped export manifests consigned to a cartel holding corporation three jumps away.
The elder brother's escort gunboat displays an industrial registry number belonging to a cartel subsidiary.
A commercial board lists a buyout option on the family blast furnace expiring on the first day of the fiscal quarter.

radio_hooks: Smelters union warns of impending regional alloy shortages due to feuding furnace docks.
Foundry cartel announces strategic investment options across independent orbital steelworks.
Industrial commodities desk notes severe spot price volatility for certified silicate flux.

voice_direction.elder_brother: Cold, imperious, and patronizing. Frames cutthroat corporate maneuvers as natural economic Darwinism and speaks of his brother with clinical disappointment.
voice_direction.younger_brother: Fiery, hoarse, and combative. Speaks in passionate union slogans and slams his hand on bulkheads when discussing corporate cartels.
